info.title: Openrail API
info.description: Core Openrail API (blueprint 1.7) plus the hosted pay, acknowledgement and claim views. JSON only. Errors are `{error:{code,message,rule?}}`.

secretKey.description: Server-only secret key. Stored as sha256, scoped to one business, shown once.

publishableKey.description: Browser key for creating pay sessions and reading routes only.

sessionAuth.description: Dashboard session from POST /v1/auth/verify or the or_sess cookie; 7 days sliding, capped at 30 days; scoped to one business account.

sessionCookie.name: or_sess
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax dashboard session cookie; 7 days sliding, capped at 30 days.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same key and body within 24 h returns the first response; same key with another body returns 409.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

U128.description: Unsigned 128-bit integer as a decimal string.

rule.description: Contract rule number in plain words, when applicable.

clauses.description: Core clauses first, then module clauses; input order preserved.
Additional clauses after the two core clauses.

refund_to.description: Payer refund address on the route's origin chain; the server requires and validates it per chain (EVM checksum, Solana 32-byte base58, NEAR account).

message.description: The exact string the wallet signs.

recipient.description: Must match the server recipient (the API origin).

public_key.description: ed25519:<base58> key that signed the NEP-413 message.

prefix.description: First characters of the key, e.g. or_sk_live_ab12.

secret.description: Shown once on creation or rotation.

chain_id.description: One of the pay-link EVM chain ids.

201.description: Invoice issued; the claim account exists and the pay link is live.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.
